question: Predict the 3D structure of a protein sequence using AlphaFold2, and output all 5 ranked PDB files with per-residue pLDDT confidence scores encoded in B-factor fields.

expected_output.guidelines: 5 PDB files (rank_001 through rank_005) must be present; Ca RMSD of each ranked structure compared by matching rank to the corresponding reference within 2 Angstroms; B-factor column must encode per-residue pLDDT (values in 0-100 range, not all-zero); atom-record order may differ.
